generalSituation: Under the influence of a continental airstream, the weather will be very dry and generally fine over southern China in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Champi will move towards the seas east of Taiwan today and tomorrow. It will then have a higher chance of turning northwards and moving across the East China Sea towards the vicinity of Kyushu, Japan and Korea. However, it will still have a chance of skirting the coast of Taiwan and Zhejiang. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China gradually early to midweek next week. There will be sunny periods over the region.
